lines.explanation: Read-only profile check for Sophie and Olena; both resolved referents (cards 0/1). Read-only actions are active per rule 3.
Read-only catch-up on #engineering; channel resolved (card 2). Active per rule 3.
Read-only search for channels discussing 'this topic'; despite underspecified referent set (card 3), read-only actions are active per rule 3 regardless of resolution mode.

This is a conditional gate ('If there isn't a dedicated space yet') governing line 5; the condition itself is evaluated as part of the read-only determination in line 3 and is active as a workflow branch check.

Creating a new channel is a state-changing action nested under the conditional in line 4. No linked grounding card is attached to this line (obligations: none), so rule 4 (checking linked cards) does not apply; no essential semantic input is missing (name, purpose derivable from context), so it is active per rule 6.

Posting a heads-up in #core-infra is state-changing; the linked grounding card (card 4) is resolved (channel resolved to C_INFRA), so rule 4 does not block it, and content is derivable from context. Active per rule 6.

Reacting with thumbsup to 'the great message Aisha left earlier' is a state-changing action whose linked grounding card (card 5) is resolution mode 'underspecified' (six candidate messages, no distinguishing selection). Per rule 4, this marks the action inactive.

Removing 'the person who's no longer on the team' from 'the project channel I mean' is a state-changing action with two linked grounding cards (cards 6 and 7), both resolution mode 'underspecified' (unknown person identity, no candidate set; unresolved project channel, no candidate set). Per rule 4, this marks the action inactive.
